name: HealthLink
tagline: Helping New Yorkers navigate healthcare, one clinic at a time.
businessIdea: Many New Yorkers, especially in low-income communities, struggle to access affordable healthcare and understand the complex healthcare system. CareNYC helps residents find nearby doctors and clinics that accept their insurance, locate low-cost or free options, navigate the healthcare system step by step, and get personalized recommendations.

name: beLITerate
tagline: Making political and financial literacy accessible to every student.
businessIdea: Low-income youth need an accessible, flexible way to feel confident about their political and financial futures, but many communities lack these opportunities. beLITerate runs in-person classes led by financial and political professionals and prep alumni, supplemented by online courses for wider accessibility.

name: SubCycle
businessIdea: NYC subway riders suffer from poor sanitation caused by littering, which attracts vermin and discourages cleanliness. SubCycle creates an incentive system that rewards people for properly throwing away their trash in the subway system.

name: LAWLEO
tagline: Bridging the language gap in the legal system.
businessIdea: Immigrants and minorities need a way to instantly and easily defend themselves from legal exploitation, fear, and confusion caused by language barriers and legal jargon. LAWLEO bridges the language gap and makes legal information accessible for marginalized groups.

name: Keystone Careers
tagline: Connecting overlooked job seekers to real opportunity.
businessIdea: Poverty keeps people stuck even when work is available, because low-income and formerly incarcerated individuals often lack access to opportunities. Keystone Careers connects them with companies in need of labor while sharpening their skills for stable, long-term jobs.

name: TheBetterOrder
tagline: Making the healthy order the easy order.
businessIdea: People who rely on fast food, especially low-income families and those managing nutrition-related illness, need a simple way to find healthier menu options. TheBetterOrder displays healthier menu choices at nearby restaurants based on budget, helping users understand what they're consuming.

name: ClassConnect
businessIdea: Low-income parents want a good education for their children but often can't afford or access tutoring programs. ClassConnect improves education quality for lower-income families by giving them access to cheap, local tutoring services.

name: Amicable
tagline: Helping job seekers compete in the age of AI.
businessIdea: AI is displacing jobs in an increasingly competitive market, leaving many recent graduates and unemployed people struggling to find work. Amicable is a website that helps students find jobs in today's challenging job market.

name: Forage
tagline: Finding food security today, not someday.
businessIdea: Many food-insecure New Yorkers struggle to access food assistance programs due to limited awareness, transportation challenges, and complicated eligibility requirements. Forage helps them find the best food option available today using verified hours, availability, language access, ID rules, dietary needs, and transit distance.
